visualReview.notes: All 12 current portable views inspected, including full turntable, front, back, base, annex, roof-cover and lion-mask details. Full octagonal silhouette, relief band, two ruined approaches, three column stumps, broken capital and open damaged annex read coherently. New covers have physical curved outer tops, arched undersides and open U-shaped ends. Cornice has returned physical steps. Lion mouths have annular lips and recessed returns, bounded by retained cornice substrate; no claim of an operational drainage passage.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All 12 current shared and geographic views inspected. New continuous rounded roof-cover stock uses shared clay_fired with roughness .9, avoiding false tile-grid joints. Main slabs, cornice and lion stock retain shared stone_marble with roughness .88; original metal and other bindings retained. Whole-model marble vein detail remains subtle and coherent. Three shared graphs, five close draw calls; unloading disposes model geometry. Flat shared-material fixture is separate from independent geographic ground.

mediumFiReview.notes: All 24 current version-2 frames inspected across noon/late lighting, economy/high quality, full silhouette, front/back/details and all four forced levels over retained source terrain. Existing lower levels preserve the whole octagon, shallow reliefs, ruined porches and annex. New craft appears at close detail without replacing lower raw streams. Distant generic context cameras show the small tower at distance; explicit front/back/detail views provide the useful facade inspection. Synthetic neighboring blocks are style fixtures, not mapped buildings. No physical-device performance certification.

geographicReview.notes: Original anchor [23.727028146386147,37.974198632639826], heading pi, +X west and +Z north toward ruined entrance porches retained. All five original map, terrain-grid, descriptor, height image and native Terrarium tile files exact. Original 65-square review grid at 2m interpolates a 3.765899m native pixel; datum 72.8751m is the original dry north floor [0,5.9]. Original footprint range -.171522..+.973345m and north approach -.118511..+.339540m remain unchanged; own footing -.45m, three steps and .9m threshold retained. All 512 current imported contact controls, 128 per level, pass over source ground, sampled relative range -.008200..+.783137m. No terrain fitting, flattening, cutout, footprint replacement or broader excavation reconstruction. Coarse urban source may not resolve archaeological elevations; another host ground field needs contact review.

fidelityReview.scope: Surviving octagonal marble clock tower, eight winged-wind reliefs, low 24-slab roof and broken capital, three-step base, two ruined porch platforms with three column stumps, and broken open southern reservoir annex.
fidelityReview.notes: Full fixed surviving exterior reviewed against five exact native named photographer CC0 originals covering front, rear, opposing sides, roof, cornice, porches and annex. Built 200 hollow rounded joint-cover pieces along all 24 original roof ribs, stepped octagonal cornice and 24 carved lion masks with physically recessed mouths. Original marble roof slabs, octagonal course wall, eight shallow winged reliefs, grilles, vents, sundials, broken capital, ruined porches, steps and open annex retained. Sculpture poses, faces, cloth, exact profiles, joint counts, damage, hidden surfaces and current patina remain simplified medium-fi interpretations; dimensions remain authored estimates. Full scope unchanged. Missing full porch columns, pediments, roofs and Triton vane are not restored. Interiors, detached archaeological fragments, site walls, retaining stairs, signs, people and landscaping excluded.

runtimeLodReview.notes: 876/3976/15924/54446 triangles and 1/5/5/5 draw calls pass strict budgets. Removed 2100 old close triangles and added 31804 physical roof-cover, cornice and lion-mask triangles. All 22642 outside original close position/normal/UV/RGB triangles exact; all three original lower raw streams exact against immutable pre-edit baseline. New cover material is clay_fired; other material bindings retained. Conservative .5/.3/.2m lower-level errors are authoring estimates, not measured global bounds.

geometryValidation.notes: Imported 262/265/265/1737 controls pass across the four actual runtime levels. All four new stock groups have even paired edge incidence, nondegenerate metric UVs, outward winding and finite attributes. Every one of 200 roof-cover pieces has tested physical outer curve, arched underside, air below arch, open U-end mouths and original slab contact. All 24 lion masks have tested mouth air, returned lips, noses, ears and brows; all eight cornice profiles have physical overhang and underside. Existing 29 independent porch, closed-door reveal, vent and open-annex controls pass. 512 independent source-ground contacts pass. Original three lower streams, 22642 surrounding close attribute triangles and five map/terrain files exact. Exact regeneration, source/runtime hash inspection, strict LODs and medium-fi audit passed. No Khronos, conservation-survey or physical-device certification.

Built physically curved/segmented ochre roof joint covers, closed stepped cornice and lion-mask spouts with real recessed mouths. No source photographic pixels embedded or redistributed. Interior water-clock mechanism, detached fragments, interpretation furniture and surrounding ruins/stairs/walls excluded.

Independent terrain retained unchanged. Archaeological ground may not be resolved by coarse urban DEM; north steps/doors and southern annex contact reviewed as a bounded preview, footprint replacement disabled.
